notes.title: Game update instructions
notes.content:
Game update instructions

I added a text prompt when loading the game. Previously, there was no loading prompt, which caused many players to think that the game was stuck when they opened it for the first time. However, during the game loading process, I only added a pure black screen to block the player, which was my mistake..

notes.title: Game update instructions
notes.content:
Game update instructions

The game size has been optimized again, and now the game is only 7.6GB, but the picture quality is almost the same

Optimized the initial loading speed of the game again, now it is possible to enter the game more quickly

notes.title: Game update instructions
notes.content:
Game update instructions 

Optimized game size, now the game has been reduced from 25GB to 10G, but there is almost no difference in picture quality

Optimized the initial loading speed of the game, now allowing for faster entry into the game

Fixed a bug that caused the return button to repeatedly appear in the beginner's tutorial if you keep pressing "ESC"

The beginner's tutorial has added a new mini map, and now you can also operate the mini map in the beginner's tutorial

The game has added a monster path, which will prompt players about the direction of movement of the monster after it appears

Modified the camera's movement rules, now the zoom in and zoom out scroll wheel is consistent with mainstream games

notes.title: Circle TD Defence War - Update content and follow-up plan
notes.content:
UPDATE

Increased the synthesis path for Level 6 equipment, now Level 6 equipment does not require a one-time purchase, but can be synthesized

​Fixed a BUG that caused the achievement system to not record well when generating a two-star or higher defense tower

​Reduced the purchase time of defense tower Summoning coupons, and can now synthesize higher-level defense towers more quickly

​Increased the purchase time of MEDALS, I found that medal merchants did not buy time, resulting in a quick way to get high level bonds through MEDALS, although this is cool, but it means that only need to serve the medal to complete the game, which is a very boring thing

Follow up plan

Adding multiple endings to the game, there's no need to worry about having to play multiple times. I hope all the content ends in one game

Adding appearance changes to small heroes may result in more small hero appearances, although they may not provide additional attributes, visually there will be different changes

Reduce the size of the game. For a tower defense game, a 19GB game is too large. I will try to minimize the game size as much as possible without sacrificing image quality

Add controllable defense tower skill release switches, allowing players to more freely control the skill release of defense towers instead of the current automatic release
